description:
The absent woman whose work with Koga inspired the winter settlement’s community. His sister preserves the stories. Whether she died, departed or vanished is unknown; she is a different person from the lighthouse keeper.

Proposed draft, as her daughter’s recollection: training once paused until visitors and Pokémon had somewhere dry to sit. The daughter continues that practice while others remember more impressive demonstrations. This gives the mother a surviving influence that can be used and argued over without deciding whether she died, departed or disappeared. It establishes no connection to the lighthouse keeper.

sections: Sections 5–6: places and characters; working names versus identities

name: Koga’s mother
